items.text: Prologue
"God our Savior desires all men to be saved."
I. THE LIFE OF MAN — TO KNOW AND LOVE GOD
God, infinitely perfect, sent his Son as Redeemer and Savior.
So that this call should resound, Christ sent forth the apostles he had chosen, and they went forth and preached everywhere.
II. HANDING ON THE FAITH
Those who welcomed the call are urged on to proclaim it.
The Decalogue and the natural law
The Decalogue is a privileged expression of the natural law.
Section 2: The Ten Commandments
"Teacher, what must I do...?"
Teacher, what good deed must I do?
IN BRIEF
The Ten Commandments state what is required in the love of God.
Article 5: The Fifth Commandment
Legitimate defense of persons is not an exception to the prohibition.

Recourse to the death penalty on the part of legitimate authority was long considered an appropriate response. Consequently, the Church teaches, in the light of the Gospel, that the death penalty is inadmissible.

footnotes.text: Francis, Address to Participants in the Meeting organized by the Pontifical Council for the Promotion of the New Evangelization, 11 October 2017: L'Osservatore Romano, 13 October 2017.

Part 4: Christian Prayer
Article 1: In the Old Testament
In the Old Testament, the revelation of prayer comes between the fall and the restoration of man.
I. CREATION — SOURCE OF PRAYER
Prayer is lived in the first place beginning with the realities of creation.
IN BRIEF
From creation onward, God calls every being from nothingness into existence.
